extension.summary: Starts Kodi's programme guide settings at the values EON works best with
extension.description:
Kodi's own defaults do not suit a service like EON. It keeps one day of guide history, so the 7 day replay archive cannot be reached, and it re-reads the whole guide from the provider once the stored copy is two hours old, which on a set-top box means a wait on almost every cold start even though the guide is already on the device.
This add-on sets three of Kodi's settings once, the first time it runs: seven days of guide history, three days ahead, and a guide refresh every 48 hours.
It is a starting value, not a lock. Change any of them in Kodi afterwards and this add-on leaves your choice alone -- it never writes them a second time. If you do want the recommended values back, switch its setting off and on again.
